usedFor: Zernio holds posts and contacts, and HubSpot updates the matching person with “Update Contact” after “New Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Zernio, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new contact in Zernio refreshes the HubSpot record found by its email.

watchOut: “Update Contact” works by email on an existing contact, and “New Contact” is polling, so expect a delay.
